'''Marlo''' was an elder [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] who was the [[Kajidii/Legends|kajidii]] of the [[Qunaalac]] [[Kajidic/Legends|kajidic]]. He was a member of the [[Grand Hutt Council/Legends|Hutt Ruling Council]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

{{Char-stub}}

==Biography==
[[File:Hologram_of_Marlo_the_Hutt.png|thumb|left|Marlo answering Jabba's summons.]]
Marlo was born on the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]] into the militaristic Hutt [[Kajidic/Legends|kajidic]], [[Qunaalac]]. Later in life, Marlo became the [[Kajidii/Legends|lorda]] of the Qunaalac clan, which earned him a position on the [[Grand Hutt Council/Legends|Hutt Ruling Council]].<ref name="Lords of Nal Hutta" />

Around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]],<ref name="SW Annual 2011">''[[Star Wars Annual 2011]]''</ref> he discussed the plans to release [[Ziro Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Ziro]] from [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] custody with other Hutt council members including [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]], [[Gorga Desilijic Aarrpo/Legends|Gorga Desilijic Aarrpo]], [[Oruba/Legends|Oruba]], and [[Arok/Legends|Arok]], because Ziro had potentially damaging information about Hutt activities.<ref name="Evil Plans" />

When Ziro was brought before the Council, Marlo spoke to the Huttese [[Vigo/Legends|Vigo]] asking if he realized that his release was a result of the [[Hutt Council records/Legends|holodiary]] he possessed. Later, the Council was entertained by [[Sy Snootles/Legends|Sy Snootles]]' [[Da Hutta Moda]] number. Later on, the Jedi appeared before the Council telling them that Ziro had escaped.<ref name="HFZ" />

Sometime later, Marlo was seen browsing through the slave selection on [[Zygerria/Legends|Zygerria]] when a dispute had erupted between a [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|slave]], [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|her master]], and a [[Zygerrian/Legends|Zygerrian]]. Marlo later attended the slave auctions.<ref name="Slaves of the Republic">{{TCW|Slaves of the Republic}}</ref>

A [[20 BBY/Legends|year later]], [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]], [[Savage Opress/Legends|Savage Opress]], and [[Pre Vizsla/Legends|Pre Vizsla]] came to the Hutt Grand Council chambers and demanded that the Hutt families join them, or die. The council refused and summoned their [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]]. During the skirmish, [[Dengar/Legends|Dengar]] was thrown into Marlo, making the large Hutt grunt in anger. After Maul and his companions fled from the chamber, Marlo and the other Hutts escaped, but left Oruba behind, leading to his [[Death/Legends|death]].<ref name="Eminence">{{TCW|Eminence (episode)}}</ref>

==Personality and traits==
Like most Hutts, Marlo did not have [[Hair/Legends|hair]]. He actually wore a [[Sha'rellian toop/Legends|Sha'rellian toop]], a small creature that lived on his head, giving him the appearance of having hair. He also had markings on his upper lips that gave the appearance of a thin mustache.
